搜索厂商、中转平台或本地服务: Search vendors, relay platforms or local services
任何兼容 Anthropic、OpenAI 或 Gemini 协议的服务: Any service compatible with the Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini APIs
根地址、/v1 或完整的 /v1/chat/completions 都可以，No: A root address, /v1 or a full /v1/chat/completions all work; Nomi finds the address for each API automatically.
每行一个；第一个是主 Key，其余按顺序作为备用: One per line; the first is the primary key, the rest are backups in order
本地服务不需要 Key。: Local services don't need a key.
所有协议都不可用，不能保存。请检查上面每一条的原因。: No API is available, so this can't be saved. Check the reason on each line above.
一个第三方供应商就能同时给 Nomi 对话和各编程助手用，协议由 Nomi 自动: One third-party provider can serve Nomi chat and every coding assistant at once; Nomi converts between APIs automatically. Official account sign-in and switching stay on the Coding assistants page.
「{0}」是本机或局域网地址，允许 Nomi 访问它吗？: “{0}” is a local or LAN address. Allow Nomi to access it?
服务不提供模型列表时，用这个模型名检测，并加入模型列表。: If the service doesn't list its models, this model name is used for detection and added to the model list.
没有拿到模型列表。请返回上一步填写测试用模型。: No model list was returned. Go back and enter a test model.
还没有第三方供应商。添加一个，Nomi 对话就能用它的模型。: No third-party providers yet. Add one and Nomi chat can use its models.
删除供应商「{0}」及其所有 Key？: Delete provider “{0}” and all its keys?
{0} 无法解密，请重新填写: {0} can't be decrypted. Please enter it again.
这里列出设置 →「模型」里启用的模型。: Lists the models enabled under Settings → Models.
还没有可切换的模型，请先在设置 →「模型」里添加第三方供应商。: No models to switch to yet. Add a third-party provider under Settings → Models first.
每个编程助手的标签都可以在右上角选「官方账号」或「第三方」。这里设置选「第三方」: Each coding assistant tab can choose "Official account" or "Third-party" in the top-right corner. Set the default model used for "Third-party" here, and which one new tabs use; the CLI's global config is not changed.
第三方的推理内容不能发给官方接口，将用带上下文的新会话继续，原会话保留。继续吗？: Third-party reasoning can't be sent to the official API, so this will continue in a new session that carries the context. The original session is kept. Continue?
这个标签用第三方模型（经 Nomi 网关）。: This tab uses a third-party model (through the Nomi gateway).
「官方」用 CLI 自己的账号；「第三方」经 Nomi 网关。只影响当前标签，下: "Official" uses the CLI's own account; "Third-party" goes through the Nomi gateway. Only the current tab is affected, starting with the next message.
终端里的 CLI 已恢复为你自己的配置和官方登录；第三方模型现在在 Nomi 的: CLIs in your terminal are back to your own config and official login. Third-party models are now used in Nomi's tabs (pick "Third-party" at the top right).
没能撤销旧版本写进 {0} 全局配置的第三方设置：{1}。请手动检查，下次启动会: Couldn't undo the third-party settings an earlier version wrote into {0}'s global config: {1}. Please check it manually; Nomi will retry on next launch.
{0} 的 Responses 接口不接受自定义工具，改用转换: {0}'s Responses API rejects custom tools; converting instead
删除 {0}？保存后生效。: Delete {0}? This takes effect when you save.
这个供应商来自环境变量，只能查看；要修改请改环境变量后重启 Nomi。: This provider comes from environment variables and is read-only. To change it, edit the environment variables and restart Nomi.
无法解密，请重新填写: Can't be decrypted; enter it again
粘贴新的 Key，保存后替换 {0}: Paste the new key; it replaces {0} when you save
名称看起来像一个 Key。名称只是备注，不会改变请求用的 Key。: This name looks like a key. The name is only a label; it doesn't change the key used for requests.
改为用它更换这个 Key: Use it to replace this key instead
添加 Key：每行一个，按顺序排在已有 Key 之后: Add keys: one per line, placed after the existing keys in order
这个供应商的模型都失败时，按顺序改用下面的模型。: When this provider's models all fail, use the models below in order.
各协议地址（留空表示关闭这个协议）: Address per API (leave empty to turn that API off)
地址改了，建议重新检测一次。: The addresses changed; detecting again is recommended.
模型限定协议（都不勾 = 自动选择）: Restrict models to APIs (none checked = automatic)
模型映射（请求里的模型名 → 发给上游的模型名）: Model mapping (model name in the request → model name sent upstream)
在终端里用 nomi-claude、nomi-codex 等命令使用第三方模型；: Use third-party models in a terminal with commands such as nomi-claude and nomi-codex; running claude or codex directly still uses your official sign-in.
已加入 PATH（新打开的终端生效）：{0}: Added to PATH (takes effect in new terminals): {0}
已加入用户 PATH（重新打开终端应用后生效）: Added to your user PATH (restart your terminal app to apply)
Nomi 会把命令所在目录加入当前用户的 PATH；关闭开关时只移除 Nomi: Nomi will add the command folder to your user PATH. Turning this off removes only the folder Nomi added, preserving existing entries and other environment variables.
还没有加入 PATH，可以用完整路径运行，或者加入 PATH。: Not on PATH yet. Run the commands by full path, or add the folder to PATH.
Windows 上 Nomi 不修改 PATH：请把上面的目录手动添加到用户环境: On Windows, Nomi doesn't change PATH. Add the folder above to your user PATH environment variable manually.
Nomi 会在下面的文件末尾加一段带标记的内容，把命令所在目录加进 PATH；关: Nomi will append a marked block to the end of the files below that adds the command folder to PATH. The block is removed when you turn this off; nothing else is changed.
生成标题、摘要、下一句提示等辅助请求用，通常选同一供应商里更便宜的模型: Used for helper requests such as titles, summaries and next-prompt suggestions; usually a cheaper model from the same provider
Key 限流（留空表示不限；超出时排队，等不到就换下一个 Key）: Key limits (leave blank for no limit; extra requests queue, then move to the next key)
